_comment: Redrawn from the Synopsys FFE with Quarter-rate Clocks in Analog-TX slide; checked against J. Kim et al., JSSC 54(1), 29-42, Jan. 2019, Figs. 4(c) and 5, DOI:10.1109/JSSC.2018.2874040.

One WaveDrom cell is 1 UI; clocks have period 4 UI. The a/b/c/d input word launches just after the ck4_0 edge at t=0 (cell 1). All flip-flops capture pre-edge values, including when input launch and capture share the same phase. Clock-to-Q and routing delays are omitted.
Colors follow input lanes: D0 yellow, D1 orange, D2 blue, D3 green. Hatched regions omit earlier pipeline data, rather than implying a reset state.

The earliest samples of the tracked a/b/c/d word are shown, including main3=a at 7 UI, pre2=a at 6 UI, and pre3=b at 7 UI. The lecture shades over these samples and starts those rows with e at 11 UI, e at 10 UI, and f at 11 UI respectively.
A->B->C->D follows b through D1 at 0 UI, D1-prime at 3 UI, D1-double-prime at 6 UI, and post1 at 9 UI. Each stage has 3 UI edge-to-edge; same-phase paths elsewhere have 4 UI.
Rendered with the locally installed WaveDrom Editor 3.7.0. Load this JSON in that editor to edit or export.
Independently verified against a connected FF netlist transcribed from Fig. 4(c), with simultaneous nonblocking updates: all 199 displayed symbol/time cells agree.

Fig. 5 contains a numeric-label inconsistency: Data_4UI<1>-prime and -double-prime show 4/8/12, but this lane-1 path must preserve 2/6/10 (b/f/j). Its aggregate input vector is also one 4-UI word ahead of the output labels if interpreted as the direct Fig. 4(c) input. This redraw uses the circuit and the explicitly defined t=0 launch instead of reproducing those inconsistencies.

foot.text: Time in UI; a/b/c/d launch at t = 0. Hatched: earlier data omitted.
